definitions.explanation: An area designated for washing, especially the space in a Japanese bathroom where you wash your body before entering the bathtub, or a sink/washing area in a kitchen or workplace.

examples.japanese: {洗|あら}い{場|ば}で{体|からだ}を{洗|あら}う。
examples.english: Wash your body in the washing area.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}の{洗|あら}い{場|ば}にはシャンプーが{置|お}いてあった。
examples.english: There was shampoo at the washing station in the hot spring.

examples.japanese: レストランの{洗|あら}い{場|ば}で{皿|さら}を{洗|あら}うアルバイトをしている。
examples.english: I have a part-time job washing dishes in the restaurant's wash area.

notes:
FORMATION:
{洗|あら}い (washing) + {場|ば} (place).

USAGE:
Most commonly refers to the washing area in a Japanese-style bathroom ({風呂場|ふろば}), where bathers wash and rinse before entering the {浴槽|よくそう} (bathtub). In Japanese bathing culture, you always clean yourself in the {洗|あら}い{場|ば} before soaking in the tub. Also used for commercial dish-washing areas in restaurants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風呂場|ふろば}の{洗|あら}い{場|ば} (bathroom washing area)
- {洗|あら}い{場|ば}で{体|からだ}を{流|なが}す (to rinse off in the washing area)
